name: spark-ds41f-1022-promotion-tp4
description: The trimmed promotion comparison of spark-ds41f-1022 at four nodes on the ring (2026-10-23), the TP3 one (promotion-suite.json) at TP4's stream count, about 14 minutes a build: model behaviour on 64 prompts at 16 streams (greedy outputs against the first arm's; it also heat-soaks the GPU), the engine grid up to sixteen requests, sixteen streams and one stream in closed loops (30 s warm-up, 180 s), real-text prefill at 32K and 131K. Its grid needs the dev-mode collective RPC.
